task: Local supplier map and prerequisite designs for variational/FEM/spectral numerical PDEs

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Integer-order W^{k,p} spaces and norms; componentwise derivatives and vector-valued conventions must be handled explicitly.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: State trial/test spaces, elementwise regularity, and norms for interpolation/error results.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: W^{k,p}_0 as a norm closure; it fixes the meaning of essential zero boundary data.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Use for H^1_0 conformity and zero extension arguments, with the source's domain assumptions.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Boundedness, coercivity and symmetry definitions for forms.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Base for Lax–Milgram, energy norms and symmetric Ritz projections.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Zero-boundary W^{1,p}_0 Poincare inequality on open domains bounded in one direction; p<∞ and its stated choice assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Coercivity of homogeneous Dirichlet energy; do not replace its domain condition with merely bounded Lipschitz without checking.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: W^{1,p}_0(Ω) compactly embeds into L^p(Ω) for bounded open Ω, no boundary regularity required; p<∞ and its AC/choice dependencies.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Compactness of the Dirichlet solution operator and duality arguments on bounded domains.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: W^{1,p}(Ω) compactly embeds into L^p(Ω) on bounded W^{1,p}-extension domains.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Use for full-space H^1 compactness only when extension-domain hypotheses are verified.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Bounded C^1 domain, 1<p<∞; bounded trace onto the fractional Slobodeckij space and a bounded right inverse.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous boundary trace and lifting. This does not supply discrete face inverse-trace estimates on shape-regular meshes.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Bounded coercive form on a Hilbert space gives unique solution and an operator estimate; its exact scalar-field and choice assumptions remain attached.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous and finite-dimensional elliptic variational solvability.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Coercive divergence-form weak equations under the carrier's stated coefficient and domain assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Alternative PDE-specific solvability supplier; inspect its assumptions instead of importing it as a generic FEM theorem.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Weak zero-Dirichlet Poisson solution for Ω open, nonempty and bounded in one direction, F∈H^{-1}; inherits the Poincare supplier and its AC/CC assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous model-problem well-posedness and energy estimate, not discrete approximation.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Global H^2 estimate under Countable Choice, bounded C^2 domain, uniformly elliptic coefficients with principal coefficients W^{1,∞}, lower-order coefficients L∞, f∈L²; estimate retains ||u||_{L²}.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Dual regularity with s=1 only under these assumptions.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Removes the lower-order L² term only with the stated uniqueness/invertibility hypothesis.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Do not silently simplify the global H² estimate absent that hypothesis.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: A reentrant-corner sector example shows H² regularity can fail on nonsmooth domains.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Supports a regularity-index s formulation rather than unconditional h^{k+1} L² rates.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Operator associated with a symmetric lower-bounded elliptic form; compactness assumptions and choice principles are explicit.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous spectral problem foundation.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Compact positive shifted solution operator yields a discrete real eigenbasis, multiplicity and eigenvalue growth under bounded-domain and AC/CC assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous exact eigenpairs and eigenbasis only.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Continuous symmetric elliptic eigenvalue min-max and max-min, with attainment and the stated AC/CC assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Combine with conforming discrete min-max to show discrete eigenvalues are upper bounds.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Compact self-adjoint operator spectral theorem, finite multiplicities and eigenvector completeness on the orthogonal complement of the kernel.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous compact-operator theory; does not prove convergence of discrete eigenpairs.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Weak eigenpair contract for the symmetric elliptic form.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Exact continuous eigenproblem notation.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Sectorial semigroup generated from an elliptic form under the carrier's accretivity and form-domain assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous-time evolution and semigroup background only.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Analytic heat-semigroup result for the Dirichlet Laplacian under its form/operator assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Continuous heat-flow context, not a finite-element error theorem.

existing_published_suppliers_inspected.scope: Abstract parabolic smoothing corollary under its semigroup assumptions.
existing_published_suppliers_inspected.numerical_reuse: Possible continuous adjoint-smoothing supplier after exact assumption matching.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Finite element meshes, reference cells and finite element spaces
facts_to_state: Cell maps, exact coverage, matching intersections, local polynomial degree, global continuity/traces and essential boundary constraints.
Shape regularity as uniform control of h_K/rho_K or affine-map condition numbers; explicitly distinguish shape regularity from quasi-uniformity.
Finite-dimensional unisolvence and the polynomial invariance/reproduction needed by the particular interpolation theorem.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Finite element definitions are algebraic/reference-map contracts; prove global conformity by matching face degrees of freedom and trace identities. Prove mesh scaling from affine Jacobian bounds and reference-cell norm equivalence.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Deny–Lions/Bramble–Hilbert, local interpolation, inverse and trace estimates
facts_to_state: Exact reference-cell domain and polynomial kernel, mesh shape-regularity and degree k.
Interpolation functionals, Sobolev regularity, reproduction, and the point-value threshold when using Lagrange nodes.
Broken-cell and face norms, p/q exponents and scaling powers in each inverse/trace inequality.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Reference-domain polynomial approximation and finite-dimensional norm equivalence; affine scaling; local trace theorem; bounded overlap when summing element neighborhoods. The source Bramble–Hilbert/Deny–Lions proof uses Rellich compactness and a finite-dimensional polynomial kernel.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Galerkin orthogonality, Cea and duality error estimates
facts_to_state: Bounded/coercive form constants and the norm in which coercivity holds.
Conformity V_h⊂V for the standard Galerkin orthogonality and Cea proof.
For the L2 gain, exact adjoint problem, dual regularity exponent s, and any boundary/compatibility assumptions.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Subtract the continuous and discrete variational identities; test by the discrete error minus an arbitrary approximant; use coercivity and boundedness. For L2, solve the adjoint equation, invoke orthogonality, and insert its stated H^{1+s} approximation bound.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Variational crimes, quadrature, nonconformity and Strang estimates
facts_to_state: Continuous/discrete trial and test spaces, comparison norm, extension of a_h, and exact discrete stability constant.
Consistency defect and operator/data quadrature errors separately; a change of integration rule is not invisible in a_h.
For a rate, degree k, quadrature exactness, coefficient/data smoothness and any small-h threshold.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Add/subtract an arbitrary discrete comparison function, use stability, boundedness, and the explicit consistency defect; apply the same argument to the lifted nonconforming space.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Babuška–Brezzi theorem, Fortin criterion and stable mixed FEM error
facts_to_state: Reflexive/Banach or Hilbert setting and dual-space convention.
Inf-sup or isomorphism condition for a on ker B plus its adjoint kernel condition; constraint inf-sup for b.
At the discrete level use ker B_h, not ker B, unless a separate inclusion is proved; require constants uniform in h for uniform convergence.
Fortin map boundedness and exact b-pairing preservation; pressure normalization and data compatibility.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Use closed range and the BNB theorem to prove continuous well-posedness; for discrete stability show constraint surjectivity / a Fortin right inverse; subtract the two saddle point systems and estimate on ker B_h, then recover pressure with the discrete constraint inf-sup.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Stokes continuous divergence right inverse and concrete stable-pair theorems
facts_to_state: Domain dimension, boundary partition, pressure mean-zero condition and mass compatibility.
Mesh family, element polynomial spaces, bubble enrichment or macroelement partition, singular-vertex exclusions, and dimension-specific restrictions.
State whether ker B_h⊂ker B; do not infer pointwise divergence-free from weak discrete divergence-free.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Prove continuous stability using Korn and a right inverse of divergence. For each discrete pair construct a Fortin map, prove a pressure-gradient bound, or verify the finite-dimensional macroelement kernel condition. Then invoke the mixed error theorem with its beta_h factors.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: CR, Nitsche and SIP-DG discrete stability and error contracts
facts_to_state: Matching affine mesh and shape regularity, local polynomial degree and boundary treatment.
Method-specific broken norm, penalty scaling and lower threshold.
Exact solution regularity sufficient for flux/normal traces; adjoint regularity for L2 estimates.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Prove norm definiteness/discrete Poincare, use inverse-trace bounds for coercivity, derive elementwise consistency identity, bound its dual norm, and apply Strang. Use a duality lemma only with the exact adjoint smoothing index.

facts_to_state: PDE coefficient/data regularity and oscillation terms, bubble enrichment or local lower-bound mesh assumptions.
Marking parameter, Dörfler bulk criterion, refinement closure, shape regularity, interior-node/mesh-reduction properties.
Symmetric versus nonsymmetric form; for convection include the small initial mesh condition from the proof.
Optimal complexity requires an explicit approximation class and a mesh-count estimate; the source's general theorem proof is imported, not contained in the read notes.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Residual representation → Clément/trace reliability → bubble efficiency with oscillation → marked local lower bound → estimator/oscillation reduction → error contraction → refinement-complexity accumulation.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Parabolic evolution triple and spatial/temporal Galerkin estimates
facts_to_state: V↪H↪V*, time-space regularity and continuous H-valued trace at t=0.
Measurability, uniform boundedness and coercivity of a(t;·,·), forcing space and initial datum.
For semidiscrete FEM, Ritz projection and projected time-derivative defect; for fully discrete schemes, time-step polynomial degree, jump convention and temporal regularity.
L2-in-space error needs a backward adjoint smoothing estimate; do not infer it from semigroup generation alone.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Evolution-triple trace and integration by parts → space-time BNB or energy argument → discrete energy estimate → Ritz projection error equation → dual backward problem and spatial/time interpolation.

facts_to_state: Conforming symmetric generalized eigenproblem, compact solution operator and multiplicity convention.
For nonnormal/nonconforming settings: operator norm convergence, uniform stability, primal and adjoint regularity on generalized eigenspaces, ascent and spectral isolation.
Distinguish eigenvalue averages, individual eigenvalues, invariant-subspace gap and eigenvectors; rates differ.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Use min-max for one-sided conforming bounds; represent the discrete solution as a Ritz projection and bound on the first-m eigenspace; for general compact operators prove norm convergence and apply generalized eigenspace perturbation estimates.

missing_prerequisite_designs.topic: Spectral approximation on bounded intervals and periodic domains
facts_to_state: Interval, boundary conditions, Jacobi weights and the precise weighted Sobolev class.
For Fourier collocation, periodicity; for Chebyshev, boundary-node treatment and quadrature rule.
Analyticity/smoothness assumptions for exponential rates; polynomial degree and quadrature exactness for Galerkin matrix identities.
Numerical spectral-radius/conditioning observations must be separated from proved stability/error theorems.
missing_prerequisite_designs.proof_route: Orthogonal-polynomial coefficient decay and Jacobi projection identities; interpolation remainder at Gauss–Lobatto nodes; for BVP collocation, derive differentiation matrices and eliminate boundary unknowns before establishing stability/error.

established_results_awaiting_local_proof: Cea and Strang estimates, with their stated stability/conformity/consistency assumptions.
Uniformly stable classical Stokes pairs under the exact polynomial, dimension and mesh assumptions reviewed in the source notes.
Residual reliability/efficiency and adaptive contraction under the source's estimator, oscillation and refinement hypotheses.
Finite-element eigenvalue/eigenfunction convergence under compactness, conformity or Babuška–Osborn operator hypotheses.
Parabolic Galerkin energy and error estimates under the stated evolution-triple and regularity conditions.

open_problem_candidates.statement: Prove at least one of the four alternatives A–D in the CMI Fefferman problem statement: global smooth solution for all smooth admissible unforced data on R^3 or the periodic torus, or an admissible forced breakdown example on the corresponding domain.

scope_exclusions: steady Stokes well-posedness and discrete Stokes stability
Leray weak existence and CKN partial regularity

source_specific_unverified_claims.claim: Second-order error estimate for the consistent pressure-splitting scheme in Shen–Tang §7.4.
source_specific_unverified_claims.evidence: The source reports numerical evidence and says a rigorous proof was not available at its publication time.
source_specific_unverified_claims.treatment: Do not tag as a current open problem without newer authoritative status evidence; do not treat it as an established theorem on this source alone.

dependency_policy: Reuse a local published item only when its exact hypotheses and declared assumptions match the numerical claim.
A source book/lecture theorem is not itself a local logical supplier; every new theorem needs local definitions and proof dependencies.

Keep the CMI open-problem candidate's logical supplier dependency list empty. Numerical schemes, weak solutions, Stokes results and partial-regularity theorems do not feed into the global regularity claim as proof dependencies.
An established theorem awaiting local proof is not intrinsically an open problem.
